pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
If the Nespresso app has ever paired with this machine, its pairing key is stored in your Nespresso account. Paste it below and the app keeps working.

To get it: log in at nespresso.com in a browser, open the DevTools console on that page, and run the snippet from the integration's README. It prints the pairingKey for each of your machines. It has to be a real browser, because those API calls reject scripted clients.

Leave the field empty only if this machine has never been paired, or you have factory-reset it. Home Assistant will then generate and store a new key.

data_description.pairing_seed: 32 hexadecimal characters. Leave empty to generate a new one.

error.invalid_seed: That does not look like a pairing seed. It must be at least 15 hexadecimal characters (normally 32).
error.not_found: The machine is not in range of any Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the machine. Make sure it is powered on and not currently connected to the phone app.
error.timeout: The machine stopped responding part-way through. Close the Nespresso phone app so it is not holding the connection, make sure the machine is awake and near the Bluetooth adapter, then try again.
error.auth_failed: The machine rejected that pairing seed. It is bound to a different key.
error.already_paired: This machine is already paired, most likely with the Nespresso phone app. Recover its existing pairing key from your Nespresso account (see the README) and paste it above; no reset needed. Factory-resetting the machine also works, but unpairs the app.
error.onboard_failed: Pairing failed. Try moving the machine closer to the Bluetooth adapter, or power-cycle it and retry.

abort.already_configured: This machine is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Nespresso Smart machines found. Make sure the machine is powered on and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
abort.not_supported: This machine is not supported by this integration.
